title: Le'Veon Bell is jailed in Canton

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Le'Veon Bell is jailed in Canton
sources.description: Former NFL running back Le'Veon Bell, who once seemed to be on track to have a bronze bust in Canton, is currently staying in town for a very different reason.
